package.title: Messenger UX batch: mobile /settings navigation, bot attachment file lists (mock), feed autoscroll, search-modal focus

specification.intent: Four operator-reported UX defects of the messenger surface, frontend-only: mobile /settings items are dead taps (the right pane has no mobile rule and is clipped away); message attachments render as one generic «Вложение» link instead of a readable file list (bot answers in AI chats get a marked mock list while the bot is disabled); the feed never autoscrolls (entry/send/receive) because every store emit recreates the Messenger hbs-children without CDM/CDU while the page scroll listener dies with its replaced node and the page CDU compares messages the mapper never maps in; the add-user search modal never focuses on open and loses focus when the typed text is fully cleared.

requirements.title: Mobile /settings: pane navigation for all six sections
requirements.description: ProfilePage gains controller-free settingsPaneOpen UI state; each of the six onSelect* handlers sets {section, settingsPaneOpen: true}; onSettingsBack closes the pane keeping the current section. profile.hbs root grows the chat_pane-open modifier (chats-page precedent) and the changing pane gains a settings-section__back button (data-testid settings-back) as its first child, desktop-first hidden. chat.scss mobile block (<768): chat__container-profile-changing display:none by default, display:flex under chat_pane-open (the existing pane-open users-hiding rule already covers the sidebar; the existing pane-open container-chats rule is irrelevant to this page — no such child); the modifier is inert >=768. settings-sections.scss owns the back-button styles after the messenger__back precedent (display:none desktop, inline-flex + chevron inside the mobile media). No comments in scss. Tests: each of the six items opens the pane (root modifier + that section's settings-section-* testid visible), back closes while keeping section, existing desktop suites unchanged.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-02 item 1 (check ALL settings items on mobile)

requirements.title: Messenger component surface: attachment file lists (mock bot set), modal focus, scroll-memory extraction
requirements.description: One owner for the whole components/messenger + components/message surface (the write-sets cannot be split: the attachment mapping seam, the modal focus handlers and the scroll-memory extraction all live in messenger.ts, and the pinned «Вложение» render expectations live in messenger.test.ts). (a) Attachments: Message.attachments?: {name, url}[] additive in types.ts; message.hbs replaces the single fileUrl link (both the «Вложение» and the autoDownload-gated «Скачать» branches — no preview exists to gate; the preference stays for future previews and the settings hint stays honest because the list always provides «Скачать») with a list: per item an icon img /images/file-{kind}.svg (kind from the name extension: pdf; xls/xlsx->xlsx; doc/docx->doc; else generic), the escaped name (double-brace), a «Скачать» link (href=item url, download attribute, data-testid attachment-download). messenger.ts mapping (withMessenger/mapTypedMessages seam): any message with fileUrl gets attachments; AI chat (chatInfo.is_ai) + incoming (!isMine) -> the marked mock list from components/messenger/bot-attachments.mock.ts (first item keeps file.filename when present, every url is the real download url; loud MOCK-removal header); otherwise a single {name: file.filename ?? 'Файл', url}. Four new public/images/file-*.svg icons (24x24, currentColor); messenger.scss list rows on existing theme tokens. (b) Focus: the add-user cross handler resets addUserQuery and focuses [data-testid user-search-input] in the next frame (refocusSearchInput reuse); the empty-query branch of the input handler refocuses after its immediate setProps re-render; the debounced-response refocus stays. (c) Scroll-memory extraction (review F-1 revision — behavior identical): the Messenger scroll machinery is NOT dead and stays — Messenger-INTERNAL setProps (modal open/close, reply draft, member menu, search state, autoDownload subscription) re-render the LIVE instance and its planMessagesScroll('preserve') restores the reading position after those re-renders (feed and modals share one .messenger element); only the store-driven half is dead (the page store handler re-renders the page and detaches the live Messenger before its own store handler runs). This wave extracts the scroll state into a new shared module src/components/messenger/feed-scroll.ts (per-chat memory Map, one-time document-capture installScrollSync with class guard/300ms echo window/pinned<120px, and the coalesced plan helper); messenger.ts sources all of it with zero behavior change (the CDU preserve path stays in effect); messenger.hbs keeps passing autoDownload to Message (prop reserved for future previews — recorded decision, review F-3). Honest naming note (review F-2): no adapter populates Message.file at runtime, so file.filename is fixture-only and real non-AI file messages render the «Файл» fallback. The chat-list and WS-notification «Вложение» placeholders are a different surface — untouched. Tests: message rendering (icon kinds incl. docx->doc/unknown->generic, XSS-escaped name, href/download, absent without attachments); the mapping rule (AI incoming -> mock list with first name from file.filename when present, own/non-AI -> single, no file -> none); focus on open + focus kept after a full clear; the pinned «Вложение» feed-render expectations updated to the list UI.

requirements.title: Page-owned feed autoscroll engine + contacts modal focus + docs
requirements.description: The chat page owns the store-driven scroll engine (its own header comment already assigns the feed scroll here; the page instance is the only stable owner across store re-renders), built on the SHARED scroll module extracted by WS-FE-MESSENGER (components/messenger/feed-scroll.ts — pages->components is a legal downward import; one memory for both writers, disjoint triggers: the page reacts to store emits, Messenger-internal preserve plans react to its own setProps). The engine consumes the shared per-chat memory + the one-time document-capture sync, replacing the page's per-node CDM scroll listener (dead after the first re-render) and deleting the page's dead CDU branch comparing never-mapped messages (always 0/0). Page CDU reads the STORE for the selected chat's messages: chat change -> delete memory + plan bottom; tail growth (length grew with the head id unchanged — append, NOT «загрузить ещё» prepend) AND (pinned OR the last message isPending typing-placeholder) -> bottom; else -> restore the saved top. One coalesced rAF plan per frame on the live .messenger__container (the last CDU of a cascade wins); the CDM entry-with-selectedChat bottom scroll stays (openDm return). Contacts page mirrors the modal focus (focus on open next frame + empty-query branch refocus; the search-response refocus already exists). Docs: NEXT.md record + progress_log entry on top with the mock-removal pointer. Tests: chat.test.ts decision table with flushed frames (chat change -> bottom + memory cleared; append pinned -> bottom; append unpinned -> saved top; prepend -> saved top, never bottom; pending tail -> bottom regardless); contacts.test.ts focus on open.

specification.goal: The four reported UX defects are gone: mobile /settings works, attachments read as file lists, the feed autoscrolls, the search modal focuses.
constraints: Layers only downward; guard-architecture --all --strict stays 0; components never import features/controllers; the mock data lives in components/messenger (bot semantics already live in the message layer), not in features/ai-assistant.
Frontend-only: backend/** is a forbidden write; no store-shape, WS-protocol, routing or dependency changes.
No comments in new/edited scss (stylelint); imports with .ts extension; 4-space/single-quote/no-semicolon style enforced by eslint:fix.
Message.attachments is additive; file_url/file stay (list snippet and mapping seams depend on them); the «Вложение» placeholders of the chat list and WS notifications stay untouched.
Existing suites stay green; mocha counts grow from the 568 base.
nonGoals: real bot multi-file message contract (the marked mock is the seam)
image/media attachment previews and the autoDownload preview gate
«Найти все чаты» and RAG carry-over work
scroll preservation across full page reloads; virtualized lists
ai-assistant page restyle in dark theme
specification.scope: profile page mobile pane + settings/back scss; messenger component surface (attachment list + icons + mock + types + modal focus + scroll-memory extraction into the shared feed-scroll module); page-owned store-driven autoscroll engine + contacts modal focus + docs; evidence under work/2026-11-02-ui-ux/.

criteria.title: Mobile /settings navigation proven by mocha
criteria.statement: Each of the six sidebar items opens the pane (root chat_pane-open + that section's settings-section-* rendered); the back button removes the modifier preserving the section prop; desktop switching and the existing settings suites stay green; the mobile CSS hides chat__container-profile-changing below 768 and shows it under chat_pane-open with the modifier inert >=768 (rules live inside the mobile media block).

criteria.title: Attachment lists + modal focus + scroll-memory extraction proven by mocha
criteria.statement: Attachments render one row per item — icon by extension (pdf; xls/xlsx->xlsx; doc/docx->doc; else generic), escaped name, «Скачать» link with the item url and download attribute; the mapping pins AI-chat incoming -> marked mock list (first name from file.filename when present — fixture-only at runtime since no adapter populates Message.file, real bot names come from the mock set; real urls), own/non-AI -> single item rendering the «Файл» fallback name at runtime, no file -> no list; the old single-link rendering is gone from message.hbs; the chat-list and notification «Вложение» placeholders and their suites stay untouched; the mock is single-sourced with a removal marker; the add-user modal focuses the input on open (query cleared) and keeps focus after a full clear; the scroll memory/sync is extracted to components/messenger/feed-scroll.ts with the Messenger preserve path intact (zero behavior change) and suites green.

criteria.title: Autoscroll decision table + contacts focus proven by mocha
criteria.statement: Store-driven page re-renders with flushed frames show: chat change -> bottom + memory cleared; tail append while pinned -> bottom; tail append while NOT pinned -> the saved top restored (reading history never yanked); head growth («загрузить ещё» prepend) -> saved top, never bottom; a pending typing-placeholder tail pins the bottom regardless; the engine runs on the shared feed-scroll module alongside the intact Messenger preserve plans (disjoint triggers, one memory). The contacts add-modal focuses its input on open.

criteria.title: Gates and bookkeeping
criteria.statement: npm run verify exit 0 with mocha counts grown from the 568 base; guard strict 0 at final; no file outside the manifest write-sets changes (ownership audit clean); NEXT.md + progress_log carry the run record with the mock-removal pointer; rides feature/2026-11-02-ui-ux (base dev 7dbd7aa); backend untouched.

releaseImpact: Profile page mobile pane state + settings/back scss; message attachment list UI with four new svg icons + additive Message.attachments + marked mock module; modal focus fixes (messenger + contacts); shared scroll-memory module (behavior-identical extraction) + page-owned store-driven autoscroll engine alongside the intact Messenger preserve path; docs. No backend, store-shape, WS-protocol or dependency changes.
nonGoals: scroll preservation across reloads; virtualized lists

securityGates.statement: Attachment names and every new user-visible string render double-braced or through escapeHtml builders; download hrefs come only from the fileUrl()-built safe URLs (joinUrl) — mock items reuse the real url, never a crafted one; no raw triple-brace injection outside pre-escaped builders.
